detailed_description:
Game Introduction:

3D Minesweeper is an innovative work of classic minesweeper gameplay, expanding two-dimensional logical reasoning to three-dimensional space. You will enter a new dimension of terrain and embark on an epic journey of wisdom and perseverance!

Main gameplay:

Players need to accurately calculate the distribution of minefields by calculating the 26 adjacent blocks around each cube in a 3D chessboard, gradually uncovering the hidden landmine network.

Game features:

▌ Mountain Relocation Plan: Big, bigger, huge! Challenge different plots of land and conquer towering mountains!

The game draws inspiration from the ancient Chinese fable 'Foolish Old Man Moves Mountains', and faces the exponentially growing complex terrain of various sizes and shapes, with each piece of land harboring hidden dangers. You need to be like the modern 'Foolish Old Man Who Moves Mountains', using the shovel of logic to break through layers of fog and dissolve all obstacles you see.

▌ Instant save: Supports interrupting/resuming levels at any time, preserving your flow and allowing brain burning puzzle solving to perfectly adapt to fast-paced life.

Fast, faster, and confident in pursuing the ultimate speed, without causing a global collapse due to a single click error.

Whether it's a 5-minute leisurely decompression or hours of deep strategy challenges, progress can be saved at any time.

▌ Mind immersion: What changes have occurred to the original minesweeper formula from 2D to 3D? Waiting for you to explore

Slow, even slower, the complex information contained in three-dimensional space allows Minesweeper to return to thinking from extreme speed.

The increase in dimensionality not only makes the environment more complex, but also brings about vast boundaries.

When encountering difficulties, you can choose to delve into and overcome them, or you can choose to find another way out.

▌ Zen inspired Rain and Snow: Simple Page, Random Weather

Set your favorite time and weather, and do what you like in your preferred environment.

Hardcore reasoning and poetic dwelling reconcile here, whether you are a strategy enthusiast or a casual player, you can find your own rhythm in the voxel universe.

▌ Perpetual Inheritance: Make every conquest an immortal monument

Is the end of the game the destruction of the world? Does your effort translate into a string of clearance time numbers?

No, the end of the journey is conquest, and the world you have cleared will be in your hands.

When you are tired from the journey, you can choose to temporarily stop and go back to see the world you have, staying there and doing nothing.

Have you decided to embark on your adventure and journey?

PS: The translation from Chinese to English is completed by a translator

Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent (SSE2 instruction set supported)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11-compatible GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 / AMD Radeon HD 5770 or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not
